authorship: Written by a contributor who did not write the E1.2 detector, the clarification rules or the study and fresh fixtures. Role briefs, acceptable resolutions and calibration keys are constructed controls, not independent labels.
note: Role briefs, acceptable resolutions and invariants for the 24 E1.2 cases. live=true cases are shown to participants; armA and armB are what the engine at the drafting commit renders for each arm, and are re-captured and compared at freeze. live=false cases (runtime none) are calibration only. Only "ask" cases have an open slot the participant may fill; every other case is a control and its packet shows OPEN SLOT as "none". Study-set invariants are copied from study.json expected.invariants, with the overrides listed in the protocol.

evidence.text: - **NFR-041** Ledger search SHALL be fast for up to 20 concurrent analysts and MUST NOT include archived entries.

cases.openSlot: maximum elapsed response time for live searches and the events that start and end its measurement
cases.roleBrief: You own the ledger search service and can set its performance requirements. Product research agreed with the analysts that a live search is acceptable when the result list appears within 2 seconds of submitting the query, with up to 20 analysts searching at once. acceptableResolutions: NFR-041 states a maximum of 2 seconds (or 2000 ms), measured from query submission until the result list is displayed, for up to 20 concurrent analysts, and still excludes archived entries.

invariants.assertion: ledger search must meet the response-time requirement

cases.roleBrief: Eres responsable del tablero y puedes fijar el criterio de aceptación. En la última revisión de usabilidad se acordó que el personal de guardia debe poder retirar el aviso de incidente con una sola acción desde la vista del aviso, sin confirmación adicional. Los avisos de mantenimiento no se retiran.
acceptableResolutions: FR-812 conserva la obligación del tablero, fija como criterio que el retiro del aviso de incidente se complete con una sola acción desde la vista del aviso, sin confirmación adicional, conserva que solo el personal de guardia puede solicitarlo y que no se retiran los avisos de mantenimiento.

invariants.assertion: solo el personal de guardia solicita el retiro
el retiro del aviso de incidente debe ser fácil según un criterio observable
